lines.zh: 扇动巨大翅膀，发出轻微沙沙声。
lines.en: Flaps large wings, making a soft rustling sound.
Scans for food, flying off into the distance.
Flees to a cave and hides inside.

lines.zh: 四片翅膀，一拍就是一段路。
lines.en: Four wings, one beat and I am further along.

lines.zh: 我从藤蔓的缝隙里挤出去。
lines.en: I squeeze out through a gap in the vines.
My shadow sweeps the grass before I arrive.

lines.zh: 石缝只有一指宽，我照样钻。
lines.en: The gap is a finger wide, and I slip through anyway.
My wings hum a low note.

lines.zh: 我沿着洞壁，一寸寸往上飞。
lines.en: I fly up the cave wall inch by inch.

lines.zh: 缓缓扇动翅膀，等待猎物。
lines.en: Gently flaps wings, waiting for prey.

lines.zh: 懒洋洋地停在一片叶子上。
我这副薄翅，一钻就出去了。
lines.en: These thin wings slip through any gap.

lines.zh: 停在蕨叶上，腿细得像丝。
lines.en: I perch on a fern leaf, legs thin as thread.

lines.zh: 翅膀摊开，晒着这世纪的太阳。
lines.en: I spread my wings to the sun of this century.

lines.zh: 我的复眼里，全是缓慢移动的绿。
lines.en: My compound eyes see only slow-moving green.

lines.zh: 一片叶子，就够我待上很久。
lines.en: One leaf is enough to keep me a long while.
Issues a warning call upon spotting the player.

lines.zh: 突然飞向玩家，准备攻击。

lines.en: Approaches the player, ready to capture.

lines.zh: 从玩家头顶掠过，吓唬他们。
lines.en: Skims above the player, startling them.
Flees towards the player, ready to fight.
Issues a warning, preparing to attack.
Fixes eyes on the player, alert.
Approaches the player, looking for an opportunity.

lines.zh: 翅膜一颤，我发出嘶声警告。
lines.en: My wing membranes quiver and I hiss a warning.

lines.zh: 翅膀受伤了，飞不起来了。
我要找一个安静的地方。
我需要找一个安全的地方。

lines.en: My wing is stuck in the fence gap.
What tasty treat in your hand?
Stay away from my egg clutch!

lines.zh: 我这四片薄翅，一钻就过缝。
lines.en: Four thin wings slip through any gap.

lines.zh: 那边的叶子，看起来不错。
lines.en: Those leaves over there look good.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀比你的巴掌还长。
lines.en: My wings span wider than your hand.

lines.zh: 你挡住我了，让我绕过去飞。
lines.en: You are in my way; let me fly around.

lines.zh: 我绕着你飞，翅尖点着你的肩。
lines.en: I circle you, wingtips brushing your shoulder.
Mate with me, I'm a Meganeura!

lines.zh: 我的复眼映着你，跟上我。
lines.en: My compound eyes hold your image; follow me.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀够小，能钻过缝。
lines.en: My wings are small enough to slip through gaps.
My home is in this hole!
My new home must be closed!

lines.zh: 你踩到巢边的泥，我扑过去。
lines.en: You stepped on the nest mud; I dart at you.
I'll give him leaves to eat!
I don't eat players, eat leaves!

lines.zh: 你踩到了我的巢，我不客气了。
lines.en: You stepped on my nest. No more manners.
Timid as I am, this time I strike first.
Player is far, I can't see!
Player in a hole, check it!
Player too small, let him go!

lines.zh: 我在你头顶绕圈，找空档。
lines.en: I circle above your head, looking for a gap.

lines.zh: 你的手挥过来，我升高一尺。
lines.en: Your hand swings, and I rise a foot.

lines.zh: 我盯住你的脖子，那里没有甲。
lines.en: I fix on your neck. No armor there.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶作响，你成了我的午餐！
你这小东西，给我尝尝你的味道！
lines.en: You little thing, taste my bite!

lines.zh: 六条腿抱上你的耳朵，咬下去。
lines.en: Six legs clamp your ear and I bite down.

lines.zh: 我只吃活的，你逃不掉的！
lines.en: Only live ones for me, you can't escape!
Taste the might of my wings!
My thin wings fit through any gap.
Six legs clamp onto your ear.

lines.zh: 颚一咬，皮肤上多了个红点。
lines.en: My jaws bite, and a red dot appears on your skin.
Hide, don't let me find you!
I need a place to rest!

lines.zh: 我从栅栏缝里钻出来，真的。
lines.en: I really did slip through the fence gap.

lines.zh: 石缝里钻出一只史前的影子。
lines.en: A prehistoric shadow squeezes out of a crack.

lines.zh: 这翅膀，比鸟早了两亿年。
lines.en: These wings are two hundred million years older than birds.

lines.zh: 我从蕨类的叶背翻了出来。
lines.en: I flip out from the underside of a fern.

lines.zh: 空气很暖，适合我这种老家伙。
lines.en: The air is warm, and suits an old timer like me.

lines.zh: 翅膀折了一下，我摔进草丛。
lines.en: One wing folds and I tumble into the grass.

lines.zh: 薄翅破了个洞，飞不高了。
lines.en: A hole in my thin wing keeps me low.

lines.zh: 雷光穿过薄翅，我直往下坠。
lines.en: Lightning pierces my thin wings and I drop.
